baseline_change_provenance: Both product headers, their nonstandard include closure, three original unit sources, AGENTS.md and verify/Mac workflows are byte-identical between prior screen829efa17 and new baselineb584f748; see baseline-refresh.json. Previous screening evidence retains its original provenance.

dupselect.semantic: exact valid duplicate occurrence, including high occurrence indices

sample_policy.replays: For each exact case/flag within a job, R=min(4096,max(1,ceil(1.5/minimum_pilot_cpu_over_all_its_distinct_variants)))). Use that same R for every AA/BB and cross-variant leg of that case/flag. Exactly one one-replay pilot per distinct variant/case/flag; no adaptive retuning.
sample_policy.warmup: For warm-cache nonempty fresh objects,1024 access calls before timing; build-from-empty has no prebuilt object and therefore no access warmup; no full-workload prewarm
sample_policy.interleaving: cycle outermost, fixed cyclic/reversed case order within each flag; calibration and controls span the job rather than finishing one case entirely first
sample_policy.cross_block_log_contrast: D=(log(B1)+log(B2)-log(A1)-log(A2))/2; exp(D) is the B/A latency ratio for one complete ABBA or BAAB block
sample_policy.statistical_unit: Eight complete four-sample cross-block contrasts per pair/case/flag; not 16 independent paired observations
sample_policy.AA_BB_log_contrast: log(second/first) within each same-binary pair; retain signed drift and absolute envelope separately
sample_policy.thresholds_purpose: Descriptive resolution/adverse flags only; not acceptance or merge criteria
sample_policy.full_size_preflight_check: Each of three fresh replays must have exact complete outputs and final state; one full-input independent C++ oracle per exact input/kind/type key establishes verified expected bytes; all later candidates and flags require exact input and full output/final byte equality to that verified record

runner_policy.parallel_limit_scope: At most two timing shards concurrently; Linux/Mac/sanitizer gates and normal CI may run concurrently

record_schema: input stream/output array/final vector SHA256 and byte lengths
replay count and replay index checks
failure_reproduction: exact deterministic input parameters and generator hash
first failing operation index and expected/actual result
bounded surrounding operations and final-state mismatch window
log_policy.log_truncation: Marks job incomplete; never claim a passing unlogged comparison
log_policy.oracle_boundary: Full-size independent C++ vector oracle once per exact input/kind/type key, then exact verified full input/output/final byte reuse across candidates/flags; separate small Python vector oracle for every variant/case/flag

full_oracle_policy.reuse_requires: exact full input and output/final bytes, not hashes alone
full_oracle_policy.scope: Ephemeral verification records in this disposable job only; no persistent/GitHub/cache service writes
full_oracle_policy.failure_policy: Retain failure by exact key; no retry or baseline-only fallback; timeout marks validation incomplete
full_oracle_policy.pre_freeze_gate: Cross-check the C++ oracle against the independent Python oracle on small cases; freeze source and compile command after reviewer approval
provenance: key and input/output lengths and SHA256
initial oracle result or successful exact-byte reuse relation

package.source_snapshot_status: Materialized immutable source snapshot. Source hashes are verified before execution and rechecked after timing.

purpose: Individual confirmation and regression-resolution screen for all seven high-leverage individuals, including every intended target and broad/independently shaped adverse controls; not final qualification or acceptance.
not_an_acceptance_gate_alone: Does not establish combination interactions, full64 performance, select factorial/absence/churn performance, external-reference rank, Mac compatibility, or latest-head CI.
preconditions: Own-library individual correctness gate; current native/scalar and local oracle/source review must pass
Freeze reviewed source/caller/oracle/generator/protocol hashes after local oracle passes
Include exact select-lastbit-miss/select-high-k/select-valid-dup/select-churn and narrow20 correctness cases even though broader timing is deferred
Freeze scalar ISA macro/disassembly checks and bounded reproducibility logs
Every required correctness job must pass on this exact source snapshot before any timing shard runs.

totals.correctness_gate_counts: Separate reviewed gate manifest; not included in these timing-process counts

correctness_gate_policy.timing_dependency: All first-wave Linux native/scalar, actual Mac, sanitizer-a and sanitizer-b source gates must pass; no broad workflow concurrency cap is imposed by the timing-shard limit

first_wave_sanitizers.coverage: baseline and all seven individuals; no combination-only shortcut

dependency_proof.benchmark: Each source is compiled separately with -MMD/-MF, then linked with the per-flag escape object; actual dependencies must prove both product headers resolve inside the selected variant and match frozen bytes
dependency_proof.escape: Compile once per flag/shard with a separate depfile; prove no product dependencies
dependency_proof.full_oracle: Compile/link once per shard with independent dependency proof; prove no product dependencies
dependency_proof.counts: Benchmark binaries, object compile calls, links and compile-bearing calls are counted separately; compiler identity/ISA probes remain metadata calls

freeze_rule: All 56 rows and 14 shards are frozen together before new timing. A package approval covers those shards; no repeated publications/full CI for each four-case shard. Do not omit adverse rows, retune policy from results, or automatically rerun. Failures/timeouts are incomplete.
